Readiness honesty (AC: no misleading indicators): Vision is shown On only when the live server reports the vision modality for the ACTIVE profile (brain_profile.ProfileStatus, modality_problem); identity is checked against the active profile's derived config (exact argv, n_ctx), never loosened; while a switch runs the UI shows switching and not ready; an unknown host profile is UNAVAILABLE, never READY

Vision over MTP: Vision On is always MTP off; speed boost only with Vision off at the measured 16K/32K MTP profiles; key_from_controls refuses vision+speed rather than silently dropping one; OFFERED keys all measured (RP.MEASURED_MIB)

Session state across profile switches: the conversation, task ledger and drafts survive a reconfigure (the host restarts only llama-server; the worker keeps history); a context shrink below the live conversation needs explicit confirm_shrink; a switch is refused while a turn runs or a host request is pending; no fallback to another profile on failure (last_switch NOT_READY is shown)

Image turns: images are validated (count, total bytes vs the frozen 2 MiB FRAME_LIMIT, magic bytes) before reaching the Brain; history keeps placeholders only, never bytes; image turns that would route to actions, Harness, multi-step, Core, dictation or drafts are refused with IMAGE_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED, never silently drop the image; Vision Off refuses image turns with VISION_OFF

Brain host reconfigure (scripts/ws_brain_host.py): request validation (IGNORED_INVALID_OR_STALE), GPU lease handling, REFUSED_ATTACHED for a server the host does not own, the persisted choice file brain_profile.json read at host start with errors reported, never guessed

Frozen and protected: model_lab/integration/local_brain.json and uri_core/** unchanged; profiles are derived in memory; the frozen-scope lists (tests/phase2a/test_frozen_core.py ALLOWED_NEW, scripts/phase2close_chain.py WS_EXACT) only gain the exact new paths; CRLF line endings of answer.py, test_frozen_core.py, phase2close_chain.py preserved
Thinking control: per-turn depth only (no reload), persisted choice except deep; the existing depth contract is unchanged

Flutter UI (uri_ui/lib/living/integration/brain_quick_controls.dart, oi_conversation.dart, oi_widgets.dart, ws_settings.dart, living_composer.dart): discoverability, confirmation before a reload, plain-language refusal messages for every refusal code, image scaling to the limit, no layout overflow at small sizes, no expensive effects or persistent timers; classic interface and Office composer path unchanged
user-facing work: every capability reachable and operable through the real URI Windows UI; first-time and returning user; recovery after a failed switch
